findings.description: UP uses the malformed complement trust the questioner that the problem can be solved.

contexts.japanese: ……問題は解けるように出されていると、出題者を信頼して初めて、思考の戦いは始まる」
contexts.japanesePS3: ……問題は解けるように出されていると、出題者を信頼して初めて、思考の戦いは始まる」
contexts.MG: ...A battle of wits doesn't begin until you trust the questioner and believe that it can be solved."
contexts.UP: ......A battle of wits can't begin until you trust the questioner that the problem can be solved."

findings.sourceReading: MG and original WH coordinate trusting the questioner with believing the problem solvable; UP merges the constructions without the required complement relation.
findings.alternative: The intended assurance is clear, but trust PERSON that CLAUSE is not standard prose syntax.
